_about: The tripod spotting scope on the firing line (range-day-ten): a common 20-60x scope with a large front lens, looked through between shots to read where bullets landed. It has no reticle and does not move with the rifle. Its field of view at each end of its zoom comes from the maker's page; between the two ends the view's width follows a power of the magnification fitted through both published figures.
